functions.capture_metadata:
def capture_metadata(env, files):
    # This is a new metadata invocation on the frozen source53, never a copy of
    # the old source49 workspace metadata or a claim about all feature/platforms.
    stem = PREFIX + "-metadata"
    stdout_path, stderr_path = E / (stem + ".json"), E / (stem + "-stderr.log")
    started = time.time()
    with stdout_path.open("xb") as output, stderr_path.open("xb") as errors:
        process = subprocess.Popen(METADATA_COMMAND, cwd=S / "codex-rs", env=env, stdout=output, stderr=errors)
        try:
            rc = process.wait()
        finally:
            if process.poll() is None:
                rc = process.wait()
            else:
                rc = process.returncode
            ended = time.time()
            raw_pin = write_json(stem + "-raw-process-result.json", {
                "schema": "hepta.native-raw-process-result.v1", "phase": "workspace-metadata",
                "source_tree": EXPECTED_TREE, "source_commit": EXPECTED_COMMIT,
                "command": METADATA_COMMAND, "cwd": str(S / "codex-rs"),
                "start_unix": started, "end_unix": ended, "exit_code": rc,
                "log_and_resource_hashing_pending": True,
                "resources_not_collected_for_read_only_metadata": True,
            })
    post = guard(files)
    post_pin = write_json(stem + "-source-post-verification.json", post)
    metadata_raw, stderr_raw = stdout_path.read_bytes(), stderr_path.read_bytes()
    write_json(stem + "-receipt.json", {
        "schema": "hepta.native-metadata-receipt.v1",
        "source_tree": EXPECTED_TREE, "source_commit": EXPECTED_COMMIT,
        "command": METADATA_COMMAND, "cwd": str(S / "codex-rs"),
        "start_unix": started, "end_unix": ended, "elapsed_seconds": ended - started,
        "exit_code": rc, "raw_process_result": raw_pin,
        "stdout": data_pin(metadata_raw), "stderr": data_pin(stderr_raw),
        "source_postguard": post_pin, "source_guards_pass": post["pass"],
    })
    require(rc == 0 and post["pass"], "current metadata command or source postguard failed")
    metadata = json.loads(metadata_raw)
    require(metadata["workspace_root"] == str(S / "codex-rs"), "wrong metadata workspace root")
    require(metadata["target_directory"] == str(T / "target"), "metadata used a different task target")
    members, defaults = metadata["workspace_members"], metadata["workspace_default_members"]
    require(len(members) == len(set(members)) == len(defaults) == len(set(defaults)) == EXPECTED_WORKSPACE_MEMBER_COUNT
            and set(members) == set(defaults), "actual default workspace is not all 193 members")
    packages = {package["id"]: package for package in metadata["packages"]}
    require(len(packages) == len(metadata["packages"]) and set(members) <= set(packages),
            "ambiguous or absent workspace package identities")
    scope = {
        "schema": "hepta.source53-current-default-workspace-scope.v1",
        "source_tree": EXPECTED_TREE, "source_commit": EXPECTED_COMMIT,
        "metadata_command": METADATA_COMMAND, "metadata": {"path": stem + ".json", **data_pin(metadata_raw)},
        "metadata_generated_on_current_source": True, "old_metadata_reused_as_current": False,
        "workspace_root": metadata["workspace_root"], "target_directory": metadata["target_directory"],
        "workspace_member_count": len(members), "workspace_default_member_count": len(defaults),
        "workspace_members": [{"id": identity, "name": packages[identity]["name"],
                               "manifest_path": packages[identity]["manifest_path"]} for identity in members],
        "workspace_default_members": [{"id": identity, "name": packages[identity]["name"]} for identity in defaults],
        "command": COMMAND, "features": "unchanged_defaults", "filters": "no_additions",
        "all_platforms_features_external_services_qualified": False,
        "diagnostic_only": True, "behavior_repair_claimed": False,
    }
    return scope, write_json(PREFIX + "-scope.json", scope)

functions.frozen_context_check:
def frozen_context_check(primary_pins):
    for row in primary_pins:
        require(row["path"].startswith("original/"), "unexpected primary source pin prefix")
        path = row["path"][len("original/"):]
        actual = working_file_pin(path)
        require({key: actual[key] for key in ("bytes", "sha256", "git_blob")}
                == {key: row[key] for key in ("bytes", "sha256", "git_blob")},
                "formatter/dependency/context input changed: " + path)
    require(sha((S / LOCK_FILES[0]).read_bytes()) == CARGO_LOCK_SHA256
            and sha((S / LOCK_FILES[1]).read_bytes()) == BAZEL_LOCK_SHA256,
            "dependency lock bytes changed")
functions.load_final_scope:
def load_final_scope(metadata, files, metadata_pin):
    originals = {name: pinned_read(SCOPE_DIRECTORY + "/" + name, expected)
                 for name, expected in SCOPE_INPUT_PINS.items()}
    expected, proposed, commands, primary = [
        json.loads(originals[name]) for name in (
            "EXPECTED-SELECTION.json", "PACKAGE-ARGS.json",
            "RUST-FILE-COMMANDS.json", "PRIMARY-SOURCE-PINS.json",
        )
    ]
    require(expected["schema"] == "hepta.source53-final-formatter-selection.v1"
            and proposed["schema"] == "hepta.source53-final-fix-packages.v1",
            "unexpected frozen scope schema")
    require(expected["source_commit"] == proposed["source_commit"] == EXPECTED_COMMIT
            and expected["source_tree"] == proposed["source_tree"] == EXPECTED_TREE,
            "scope preparation source differs")
    for source_pin in (expected["source_manifest"], proposed["source_manifest"]):
        require(source_pin["bytes"] == SOURCE_MANIFEST_BYTES
                and source_pin["sha256"] == SOURCE_MANIFEST_SHA256,
                "scope preparation manifest differs")
    require(proposed["fresh_metadata"] == FRESH_METADATA_PIN
            and {key: metadata_pin[key] for key in ("bytes", "sha256", "git_blob")} == FRESH_METADATA_PIN,
            "scope does not use the actual r31 metadata")
    require(expected["changed_path_count"] == len(files) == 197
            and expected["changed_paths"] == sorted(files), "scope changed path set differs")
    rust_paths = sorted(path for path in files if path.endswith(".rs"))
    require(expected["rust_paths"] == rust_paths and expected["rust_count"] == len(rust_paths) == 183,
            "exact original changed Rust selection differs")
    python_paths = ["scripts/run-nextest.py", "scripts/test_run_nextest_helpers.py"]
    require(expected["python_paths"] == ["./" + path for path in python_paths]
            and expected["python_count"] == 2
            and expected["formatting_configuration_changed_paths"] == [],
            "original default Python/configuration selection differs")
    require(expected["python_formatter_command"] == [
                "uv", "run", "--frozen", "--project", "scripts", "ruff", "format",
                *["./" + path for path in python_paths],
            ] and expected["default_formatter_command"] == ["just", "fmt"]
            and expected["all_flag_used"] is False,
            "original default formatter argv differs")
    require(expected["native_HEAD"] == FRAMEWORK_PARENT
            and expected["native_created_commit_checkout_claimed"] is False,
            "prepared formatter HEAD differs")
    member_ids, default_ids = set(metadata["workspace_members"]), set(metadata["workspace_default_members"])
    require(len(member_ids) == len(default_ids) == 193 and member_ids == default_ids
            and expected["workspace_members"] == expected["workspace_default_members"] == 193
            and expected["fresh_source53_r31_metadata_verified"] is True,
            "fresh actual default scope differs")
    package_rows = [row for row in metadata["packages"] if row["id"] in member_ids]
    roots = {}
    for package in package_rows:
        manifest = Path(package["manifest_path"])
        require(manifest.is_absolute() and manifest.name == "Cargo.toml", "unexpected metadata manifest path")
        relative = manifest.relative_to(S).as_posix()
        safe_relative(relative)
        root = PurePosixPath(relative).parent.as_posix()
        require(root not in roots, "ambiguous metadata owning directory")
        roots[root] = {
            "package": package["name"], "package_id": package["id"],
            "package_directory": root, "manifest_path": relative,
            "edition": package["edition"], "default_workspace_member": package["id"] in default_ids,
        }
    actual_owners = {}
    for path in rust_paths:
        matches = [root for root in roots if path.startswith(root + "/")]
        require(matches, "Rust path has no owner in actual fresh metadata: " + path)
        root = max(matches, key=lambda value: len(PurePosixPath(value).parts))
        package = roots[root]
        entry = actual_owners.setdefault(package["package"], {**package, "rust_paths": []})
        require(entry["package_directory"] == root, "duplicate owner name in fresh metadata")
        entry["rust_paths"].append(path)
    for owner in actual_owners.values():
        owner["rust_path_count"] = len(owner["rust_paths"])
    names = sorted(actual_owners)
    require(len(names) == 26 and names == proposed["owners"], "fresh metadata does not confirm exact26 fix owners")
    require(expected["owner_count"] == 26
            and expected["owners"] == [actual_owners[name] for name in names],
            "fresh complete owner mapping differs")
    primary_by_path = {row["path"][len("original/"):]: row for row in primary if row["path"].startswith("original/")}
    require(len(primary_by_path) == len(primary) == 34, "primary formatter/dependency context changed")
    for owner in actual_owners.values():
        require(owner["edition"] == "2024" and owner["default_workspace_member"] is True,
                "owning edition/default member differs")
        manifest = owner["manifest_path"]
        require(manifest in primary_by_path, "owner manifest is not explicitly pinned")
        actual = working_file_pin(manifest)
        require({key: actual[key] for key in ("bytes", "sha256", "git_blob")}
                == {key: primary_by_path[manifest][key] for key in ("bytes", "sha256", "git_blob")},
                "owning Cargo manifest changed: " + owner["package"])
    package_args = [value for name in names for value in ("-p", name)]
    require(proposed["package_args"] == package_args
            and proposed["command"] == ["just", "fix", "--locked", *package_args]
            and proposed["recipe_expansion"] == [
                "cargo", "clippy", "--fix", "--tests", "--allow-dirty", "--locked", *package_args,
            ] and proposed["cwd"] == str(S / "codex-rs"), "original scoped fix command differs")
    require(expected["ci_selector_count"] == len(expected["ci_selectors"]) == 27
            and len(set(expected["ci_selectors"])) == 27
            and set(expected["ci_selectors"]) - set(names) == {"codex-hepta-control-plane"}
            and expected["extra_ci_only_owner"] == ["codex-hepta-control-plane"],
            "CI-only control-plane must not expand fix scope")
    require(len(commands) == len(rust_paths) == 183, "prepared per-file formatter command count differs")
    expected_commands = []
    for path in rust_paths:
        owner = next(row for row in actual_owners.values() if path in row["rust_paths"])
        expected_commands.append({
            "path": path, "owning_package": owner["package"], "manifest_path": owner["manifest_path"],
            "cwd": str(S / owner["package_directory"]),
            "command": ["rustfmt", "--edition", "2024", "--config",
                        "imports_granularity=Item,skip_children=true", "--", str(S / path)],
        })
    require(commands == expected_commands, "prepared original per-file Rust formatter commands differ")
    require(expected["unselected_by_default_formatter"]
            == sorted(set(files) - set(rust_paths) - set(python_paths)),
            "unselected original files differ")
    frozen_context_check(primary)
    return {
        "source_tree": EXPECTED_TREE, "source_commit": EXPECTED_COMMIT,
        "source_paths": sorted(files), "rust_paths": rust_paths, "python_paths": python_paths,
        "owners": [actual_owners[name] for name in names], "package_args": package_args,
        "fix_command": proposed["command"], "format_command": ["just", "fmt"],
        "fresh_metadata_confirmed_owner_count": 26, "rust_count": 183, "python_count": 2,
        "scope_input_pins": [{"path": SCOPE_DIRECTORY + "/" + name, **data_pin(raw)}
                             for name, raw in originals.items()],
        "primary_source_pins": primary,
        "prepared_per_file_command_count": len(commands),
        "diagnostic_only": True, "behavior_repair_claimed": False,
    }
functions.verify_default_format_selection:
def verify_default_format_selection(scope):
    # Exact two read-only Git selectors used by the unchanged format.py.
    # Do not import the formatter, change HEAD, supply --base, or switch --all.
    head = git("rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip()
    require(head == FRAMEWORK_PARENT, "native HEAD changed; default formatter would select a different set")
    changed = git_paths("diff", "--name-only", "--diff-filter=ACDMRT", "--no-renames", "-z", "HEAD", "--")
    untracked = git_paths("ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard", "-z")
    require(not untracked, "unexpected untracked source changes would expand formatter selection")
    for path in changed:
        target = S / safe_relative(path)
        require(target.is_file() and not target.is_symlink(), "formatter input is not an existing regular file")
    selected = sorted(set(changed))
    require(len(selected) == len(changed) and selected == scope["source_paths"],
            "actual default HEAD change set differs from fixed source scope")
    rust = sorted(path for path in selected if path.endswith(".rs"))
    python = sorted(path for path in selected if path.startswith("scripts/") and path.endswith(".py"))
    require(rust == scope["rust_paths"] and len(rust) == 183 and bool(rust),
            "default Rust formatter scope is empty or differs from original183")
    require(python == scope["python_paths"] and len(python) == 2,
            "default Python formatter scope differs from original2")
    frozen_context_check(scope["primary_source_pins"])
    return {
        "native_head": head, "default_base": "HEAD", "changed_paths": selected,
        "rust_paths": rust, "python_paths": python, "all_flag": False, "base_override": None,
        "other_formatter_groups_selected": False,
        "selection_algorithm_bound_to_original_format_py": True,
    }
